key_insight: ProIQA assesses math item quality by modeling the full solving process, not just the problem stem, to better judge educational value.
engineering_relevance: It offers a scalable framework for automatic item generation pipelines in intelligent education systems by combining structured reasoning graphs with stem semantics.
method: Formulates IQA across knowledge concepts, difficulty, and disciplinary competencies in a unified process-aware setting.
Augments item data with structured reasoning trees derived from raw solutions.
Uses LLMs to build hierarchical reasoning trees and GNNs plus a dual-view Stem+Solving architecture to encode process and text.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on K12 mathematical datasets, showing the approach captures process-oriented features for fine-grained assessment.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of LLM-generated reasoning trees, which may introduce noise or inconsistencies.
paper_title: ProIQA: A Process-Based Framework for Fine-Grained Math Item Quality Assessment
